title: Upgrade permissions inappropriate for `ROLE_MANAGER_ROLE`
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The `_authorizeUpgrade` function in the `RoleBasedAccessControl` contract allows both `SUPER_ADMIN_ROLE` and `ROLE_MANAGER_ROLE` to authorize contract upgrades.  ```solidity     function _authorizeUpgrade(address newImplementation) internal override onlySuperAdminOrRoleManager {} ```  This design violates the best practice of **maintaining a single point of truth** for upgrade authority.
